# Stand Firm in the Gap
## Scripture
"Watch, stand fast in the faith, be brave, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Brother, the world doesn't need more passive spectators. It needs men who will hold the line. Paul's command here isn't a suggestion—it's a battle order. "Watch" means staying alert to the enemy's tactics: complacency, lust, and the slow drift of a prayerless life. "Stand fast" means rooting yourself in the truth of the Gospel when every wind of culture tries to knock you over. "Be brave" and "be strong" aren't about flexing your own muscle; they're about trusting the power of the Holy Spirit who dwells in you.

Think of a soldier on guard duty. He doesn't sleep because he knows the enemy is looking for an opening. Your family, your church, and your coworkers need you to be that guard. When you wake up, your first thought should be your mission, not your comfort. When you face temptation, your first move should be to stand on the Word, not to negotiate with it. You were built for this fight—so hold your post.

## Daily Challenge
Before your feet hit the floor this morning, pray: "Lord, make me a man who watches, stands, and fights." Then do 25 pushups, thanking Him for the strength to hold your ground today.
